name: Taiwan — 1 April 2026

BASIC.name: Basic salary

references.title: 勞動基準法 §22: the agreed monthly salary; a part month pays the days employed at monthly ÷ 30, the same day value an unpaid day deducts — or ÷ the month’s calendar days where the entity records day_wage_calendar_days (勞動部 102年11月15日勞動2字第1020083156號函: either basis by agreement, applied consistently).

BASIC.rate: period.paid_days >= period.days ? terms.base_salary / double(period.parts) : terms.base_salary / (has(company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days) && company.facts.day_wage_calendar_days == true ? double(period.month_days) : 30.0)

OVERTIME.name: Overtime (平日延長工時)

references.title: 勞動基準法 §24(1): 延長工作時間在二小時以內者，按平日每小時工資額加給三分之一以上；再延長工作時間在二小時以內者，加給三分之二以上 — each working day’s overtime: the time recorded past the planned shift’s hours in completed half-hours, less any banked as 補休 (work.days[].overtime_hours), the first two at 1.34 and every further hour at 1.67 of the hourly wage (monthly wage incl. regular allowances ÷ 30 ÷ 8). §24(1)(3): 依第三十二條第四項規定，延長工作時間者，按平日每小時工資額加倍發給 — a day the roster marks facts.emergency_extension (hours extended under §32(4) for a natural disaster, incident or emergency) is paid 2.0 for every overtime hour instead. Within the §32 limits it is not taxable salary (所得稅法 §14(1)(3)).

OVERTIME.eligibility: work.days.exists(d, !(d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"]) && !((d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20))))) && d.overtime_hours > 0.0)
OVERTIME.quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, !(d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"]) && !((d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20))))) && d.overtime_hours > 0.0).map(d, has(d.facts) && has(d.facts.emergency_extension) && d.facts.emergency_extension == true ? 2.0 * d.overtime_hours : 1.34 * min(d.overtime_hours, 2.0) + 1.67 * max(0.0, d.overtime_hours - 2.0)))

REST_DAY_WORK.name: Work on the regular day off (例假工作)

references.title: 勞動基準法 §40(1): 因天災、事變或突發事件…停止第三十六條至第三十八條所定勞工之假期。但停止假期之工資，應加倍發給，並應於事後補假休息 — one further day’s wage for each worked day whose shift is REST (the §36 例假); the rest in lieu is STATUTORY_REST_IN_LIEU. Work on a 例假 outside §40 is unlawful but its wage is still owed.

REST_DAY_WORK.eligibility: work.days.exists(d, d.day_type == "REST" && !((d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20))))) && d.worked_hours > 0.0)
REST_DAY_WORK.quantity: double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST" && !((d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20))))) && d.worked_hours > 0.0)))

REST_DAY_WORK.name: Rest-day work (休息日工作)

references.title: 勞動基準法 §24(2): 雇主使勞工於第三十六條所定休息日工作，工作時間在二小時以內者，其工資按平日每小時工資額另再加給一又三分之一以上；工作二小時後再繼續工作者，按平日每小時工資額另再加給一又三分之二以上 — the statute has two tiers only; the 2.67 kept for the ninth to twelfth hours is above its 1⅔ floor (the twelve-hour day of §32(2) counted as rest-day hours beyond the eighth), never below it. Priced on the hours actually worked — all of the day’s recorded time in completed half-hours, less any banked as 補休, counted from the first hour (the minimum-count rule was deleted 2018-03-01) on a day whose shift is OFF, the TW 休息日 (shift_definition.variant.day_type OFF; REST is the §36 例假).

REST_DAY_WORK.eligibility: work.days.exists(d, d.day_type == "OFF" && !((d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20))))) && d.overtime_hours > 0.0)
REST_DAY_WORK.quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "OFF" && !((d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20))))) && d.overtime_hours > 0.0).map(d, 1.34 * min(d.overtime_hours, 2.0) + 1.67 * max(0.0, min(d.overtime_hours, 8.0) - 2.0) + 2.67 * max(0.0, d.overtime_hours - 8.0)))

HOLIDAY_WORK.name: Public-holiday work

references.title: 勞動基準法 §39: 休假日…工作者，工資應加倍發給 — one further day’s wage (monthly wage ÷ 30) for each published holiday actually worked; a holiday not worked is already in the monthly salary. 改制前勞委會 87年9月14日(87)台勞動二字第039675號函: hours beyond eight follow §24 (HOLIDAY_OVERTIME).

HOLIDAY_WORK.eligibility: work.holidays.exists(h, h.worked && (h.kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (h.kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, h.date) >= 20)))))
HOLIDAY_WORK.quantity: double(size(work.holidays.filter(h, h.worked && (h.kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (h.kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, h.date) >= 20)))))))

HOLIDAY_WORK.name: 原住民族歲時祭儀出勤 (ritual holiday worked)

references.title: 勞動基準法 §39: work on a §37 放假日 is paid one further day’s wage (monthly ÷ 30). The ritual day worked is the roster day marked facts.indigenous_ritual_day for an indigenous worker; hours beyond eight are overtime at the §24 rates as on any holiday (the time recorded past the planned shift, priced by OVERTIME).

HOLIDAY_WORK.eligibility: has(employee.facts.indigenous) && employee.facts.indigenous == true && work.days.exists(d, d.worked && has(d.facts.indigenous_ritual_day) && d.facts.indigenous_ritual_day == true)

HOLIDAY_OVERTIME.name: Holiday work beyond eight hours

references.title: 勞動基準法 §39 with §24(1): paid hours on a holiday beyond the eighth and past the planned shift (on a planned rest or off day, every recorded hour after the eighth), less any banked as 補休, at 1.34 for the first two and 1.67 after (改制前勞委會 87年9月14日(87)台勞動二字第039675號函; 高雄市勞工局 115年休假日一覽表 附註三). They count toward the §32 monthly overtime ceiling.

HOLIDAY_OVERTIME.eligibility: work.days.exists(d, (d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20)))) && max(0.0, min(d.overtime_hours, d.scheduled_hours + d.overtime_hours - 8.0)) > 0.0)
HOLIDAY_OVERTIME.quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, (d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY", "DOUBLE_SPECIAL"] || (d.holiday_kind == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" && (has(employee.facts.voting_right) ? employee.facts.voting_right == true : (employee.nationality == "TW" && has(employee.date_of_birth) && employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, d.date) >= 20)))) && max(0.0, min(d.overtime_hours, d.scheduled_hours + d.overtime_hours - 8.0)) > 0.0).map(d, 1.34 * min(max(0.0, min(d.overtime_hours, d.scheduled_hours + d.overtime_hours - 8.0)), 2.0) + 1.67 * max(0.0, max(0.0, min(d.overtime_hours, d.scheduled_hours + d.overtime_hours - 8.0)) - 2.0)))

entries.instructions: 全國法規資料庫 (Ministry of Justice). Read 勞動基準法 (pcode N0030001) and its 施行細則 (N0030002) for the pay items: overtime, rest-day and holiday work pay (§24, §39, §40), annual leave and its pay (§38), termination notice and pay in lieu (§16), severance (§17) and old-system retirement pay (§55). Read 勞工請假規則 (N0030006) and 性別平等工作法 (N0030014) for statutory leave classes, entitlements and pay — maternity, paternity, parental, family-care and menstrual leave, childcare hours — and 育嬰留職停薪 as a suspension; 勞工退休金條例 (N0030020) §12 for new-system severance. Use 法規內容 for the article, 沿革 for amendment and commencement dates, LawAll.aspx?pcode=… for a whole Act and LawSingle.aspx?pcode=…&flno=… for one article; search by name where no pcode is given.

勞動部 (Ministry of Labor). Statute text is the law.moj entry; rulings (函釋) are in 勞動法令查詢系統, linked from 勞動法令. Read the 勞動部令 amending 勞工請假規則 and the other leave rules (新聞公告 > 新聞稿 / 公布欄), and the 函釋 on leave pay, overtime pay, average wage, suspensions and termination payments.

勞動部勞工保險局 (Bureau of Labor Insurance). Read labour, employment and occupational accident insurance — rates, the 勞工保險投保薪資分級表 and the 職災 grades, the 保險費分擔金額表 with its shares, the 職業災害保險適用行業別及費率表 — the new-system labour pension (勞工退休金月提繳工資分級表, the 6% employer contribution, voluntary worker contributions) and the 積欠工資墊償基金 levy (0.025% on the unit total). Use 業務專區 (勞工保險 / 就業保險 / 職災保險 / 勞工退休金 / 工資墊償) and 公告資訊; the tables are PDFs under /Files/.

全國法規資料庫. Read coverage, base, shares and rounding in the statutes: 勞工保險條例 (N0050001), 就業保險法 (N0050021), 勞工職業災害保險及保護法, 勞工退休金條例 (N0030020), 全民健康保險法 (L0060001) with its supplementary-premium articles, 勞動基準法 §56 and the 勞工退休準備金提撥及管理辦法 for the old-system reserve, 所得稅法 (G0340003) for salary withholding, 身心障礙者權益保障法 (D0050046) §38 and §43 for the disabled-employment quota levy, and 職工福利金條例 (N0040001) for the employee welfare fund. Use 法規內容 for the article, 沿革 for amendment and commencement dates, LawAll.aspx?pcode=… for a whole Act and LawSingle.aspx?pcode=…&flno=… for one article; search by name where no pcode is given.

行政院公報資訊網 (Executive Yuan Gazette). Read the 衛生福利部 公告 on national health insurance in the 衛生勞動篇: the premium rate, the average-dependants factor, the 全民健康保險投保金額分級表 and the supplementary premium rate (公報瀏覽, or 搜尋 for 「全民健康保險投保金額分級表」 / 「全民健康保險保險費率」). Use it too for the 勞動部 and 財政部 公告 of the insurance grade tables and withholding amounts when the agency page lacks the operative text.

財政部賦稅署 (Taxation Administration, Ministry of Finance). Read payroll income-tax withholding: the annual 綜合所得稅免稅額、標準扣除額、薪資所得特別扣除額、課稅級距 and 退職所得定額免稅 announcement, the year’s 薪資所得扣繳稅額表 with its 說明, the bonus withholding threshold and the non-resident salary rates (各類所得扣繳率標準). The amounts and table are under 公告訊息 and the page 年度綜合所得稅免稅額等金額 / 薪資所得扣繳稅額表 (/multiplehtml/06afbfc0e60e4ccb88f3f7f956aaacc7).
衛生福利部. Read the 公告 on national health insurance — premium rate, average-dependants factor, 全民健康保險投保金額分級表 and supplementary premium rate — under 最新消息 / 公告 and its 法規 links.
財政部主管法規共用系統. Read the withholding instruments and their 函釋: 所得稅法, 各類所得扣繳率標準 and 薪資所得扣繳辦法; use 法規查詢 and 最新訊息 for amendments.
Ministry of Finance eTax portal. Read the year’s 薪資所得扣繳稅額表 and the withholding rate tables for residents and non-residents; download the table files from the withholding pages.
政府資料開放平臺. Use site search for the official datasets of the 投保薪資 / 提繳工資 / 投保金額 grade tables as a cross-check; follow each dataset to its issuing agency’s 公告, which is the instrument.

全國法規資料庫. Read 勞動基準法 (N0030001) and 施行細則 (N0030002) for the limits: working hours and flexible schedules (§30, §30-1), overtime caps and classification (§32, §32-1), shift rest (§34), 例假 and 休息日 (§36), wage payment in legal tender, in full and at least twice a month unless agreed (§22, §23), the bar on pre-deducting penalties or damages (§26), child and young workers (§44–§48), and retention of the wage roster and attendance records (§23, §30). Read 最低工資法 for how the minimum wage is set and what it covers. Use 法規內容 for the article, 沿革 for amendment and commencement dates, LawAll.aspx?pcode=… for a whole Act and LawSingle.aspx?pcode=…&flno=… for one article; search by name where no pcode is given.

勞動部 (Ministry of Labor). Statute text is the law.moj entry; rulings (函釋) are in 勞動法令查詢系統, linked from 勞動法令. Read the minimum wage — monthly and hourly, one national rate — from the 最低工資審議會 decision and the 行政院 核定 under 最低工資法 §10 (新聞公告 > 新聞稿 / 公布欄), and the 函釋 on hours, overtime, rest days and wage payment.

全國法規資料庫. Read the event rules in the operative articles of 勞動基準法 (N0030001) and 施行細則 (N0030002): what a §37 holiday falling on a §36 例假 or 休息日 must cause (施行細則 §23-1), the pay-out of unused annual leave at the leave-year end or contract end (§38(4)), the pay-out of unused 補休 at its expiry or contract end (§32-1), and when severance falls due after termination (§17(2)). Use 法規內容 for the article, 沿革 for amendment and commencement dates, LawAll.aspx?pcode=… for a whole Act and LawSingle.aspx?pcode=…&flno=… for one article; search by name where no pcode is given.

勞動部 (Ministry of Labor). Statute text is the law.moj entry; rulings (函釋) are in 勞動法令查詢系統, linked from 勞動法令. Read the 函釋 on 補假 when a holiday meets a rest day, the expiry and pay-out of 補休, and the annual-leave pay-out on exit.

勞動部勞工保險局. Read the employer duties: enrolment (加保) on hire and withdrawal (退保) on exit for labour, employment and occupational accident insurance, the 勞退 提繳 申報 on hire and exit, the monthly premium bill (保險費繳款單) deadline and late fees, and the forms. Use 業務專區 > 投保單位 and 下載專區 (表單).

全國法規資料庫. Read the duties with deadlines: the payslip breakdown (勞動基準法 §23, 施行細則 §14-1), the wage roster and attendance registers (§23, §30), the mass-layoff plan and notice (大量解僱勞工保護法 N0020012 §4), the 資遣 notification (就業服務法 N0090001 §33), NHI enrolment, withdrawal and supplementary-premium remittance (全民健康保險法 L0060001 and 全民健康保險扣取及繳納補充保險費辦法), salary withholding remittance and the annual 扣繳憑單 filing (所得稅法 G0340003 §88, §92), and payment of the quota levy (身心障礙者權益保障法 D0050046 §43). Use 法規內容 for the article, 沿革 for amendment and commencement dates, LawAll.aspx?pcode=… for a whole Act and LawSingle.aspx?pcode=…&flno=… for one article; search by name where no pcode is given.
財政部賦稅署. Read the withholding remittance and 各類所得扣繳暨免扣繳憑單 filing deadlines and forms under 公告訊息 and the withholding pages.
Ministry of Finance eTax portal. Read the 扣免繳憑單 申報 deadlines, forms and filing channels; do not open any signed-in filing service.

全國法規資料庫. Read 勞動基準法 (N0030001) §2 for wage and average wage, which set the monthly-wage basis, 所得稅法 (G0340003) §7 for tax residence and the calendar tax year, and 個人資料保護法 (I0050021) for the employee data an employer may hold. Use 法規內容 for the article, 沿革 for amendment and commencement dates, LawAll.aspx?pcode=… for a whole Act and LawSingle.aspx?pcode=…&flno=… for one article; search by name where no pcode is given.

勞動部勞工保險局. Read 業務專區 > 投保單位 and the enrolment forms for the employer numbers (投保單位保險證號, 勞退 提繳單位) and the employee facts enrolment requires (identity or residence-permit number, insured wage, nationality status).

財政部賦稅署. Read the withholding pages for the employer withholding unit number and the employee facts withholding needs: residency, dependants claimed for 免稅額 and the election between the 扣繳稅額表 and the flat rate.

change_summary: 1 April 2026: a blue-collar migrant worker (employee facts migrant_worker) with under ten years at the unit leaves the 勞動基準法 §56(1) 勞工退休準備金 wage total (勞動部 114年10月14日勞動福3字第1140153402A號令). The 2026-11-28 地方公職人員選舉 投票日 joins the holiday calendar for workers with the vote. Everything else is the 1 January 2026 version.

employment_type.description: 勞動基準法 §9: FULL_TIME an indefinite-term contract; CONTRACT a fixed-term contract (record facts.fixed_term_category); PART_TIME a 部分時間工作 worker (僱用部分時間工作勞工應行注意事項).

work_classification.description: EA_COVERED: an employee under the 勞動基準法. NON_EA: work the 勞動部 has excluded from the Act (§3(3)). MANAGERIAL: a manager whose hours are set under §84-1 or outside the Act.

residency_status.description: CITIZEN: covered by employment insurance and the new labour pension, a tax resident. PERMANENT_RESIDENT: a foreigner with permanent residence, covered by the new labour pension. FOREIGNER: any other foreign worker.

residency_since.description: For a non-citizen, the day the worker became a tax resident (183 days in the tax year, 所得稅法 §7); unset is non-resident withholding.

fixed_term_category.description: 勞動基準法 §9(1), 施行細則 §6: TEMPORARY 臨時性 (unforeseeable, non-continuing, six months at most); SHORT_TERM 短期性 (expected to finish within six months); SEASONAL 季節性 (nine months at most); SPECIFIC 特定性 (finishable in a set period; over a year needs the authority’s approval). Recorded on the first terms of a fixed-term (CONTRACT) employment.

specific_term_approval_reference.description: 施行細則 §6(4): the authority’s approval reference for a specific-work contract of more than one year.

under_15_exception_reference.description: 勞動基準法 §45(1): the junior-high graduation certificate or the authority’s permit that lets a worker under fifteen be employed.

guardian_consent_reference.description: 勞動基準法 §46: the legal representative’s written consent and the proof of age kept for a worker under eighteen.

hourly_wage.description: 最低工資法 §5: a part-time or hourly-paid worker's agreed hourly wage; the MINIMUM_WAGE_HOURLY validation refuses terms below the hourly minimum wage.

worker_category.description: 就業服務法 §46(1)(9): a foreign domestic caregiver or helper employed by a household, outside the 勞動基準法 (work_classification NON_EA); the DOMESTIC_MIGRANT_WAGE validation holds the terms to the MOL wage for new and renewed contracts.

daily_hours.description: 勞動基準法 §30: the worker’s normal working hours a day (blank = 8); an hour of family-care leave draws one daily_hours-th of a personal-leave day (性別平等工作法 §20).

fixed_term.description: 大量解僱勞工保護法 §2(2): a 就業服務法 §46 fixed-term (migrant) contract, left out of the mass-layoff counts.

responsibility_system_agreement.description: 勞動基準法 §84-1(2): the reference of the written agreement filed with the local authority for a worker in an approved responsibility-system category; with company facts responsibility_system it lifts the §30, §32, §36, §37 and §49 checks.

childcare_reduction_agreed.description: 性別平等工作法 §19(2): an employer of fewer than thirty agreed with the worker, after consultation, to the one-hour reduction or adjusted hours for a child under three (CHILDCARE_REDUCED_HOURS).

lsa_termination_ground.description: The article the contract ended under. Severance is owed on §11, the §13 proviso, §14 and §20 (勞工退休金條例 §12, 勞基法 §17); notice pay on §11, the §13 proviso (§16) and §20 (which applies the §16 periods). OTHER owes neither. Required where the exit reason alone cannot tell the article: a dismissal (§11 owes severance, §12 does not), a unilateral or mutual termination, and a resignation (§14 owes severance, §15 does not); a redundancy or retrenchment is read as §11, except on a last day inside approved maternity (§50) or occupational injury (§59) leave, where it must be stated. §13 refuses §11 and §20 there; only the §13 proviso may end the contract then. Owner rule 2026-09-28: §13 is read as barring employer terminations (§11, §20), not the worker’s own (§14) nor a §12 dismissal, and every maternity leave entry is treated as the §50 stop.

average_daily_wage.description: 勞基法 §2(4): wages received in the six months before the termination day divided by the total days, excluding the periods in 施行細則 §2. Severance is 30 times this a month. Absent, a monthly-paid employee’s is read from the payslips; a daily or hourly one states it, since §2(4)’s proviso floors it at 60% of wages over the days actually worked.

old_system_service_months.description: 勞工退休金條例 §11: service on the old pension system — the whole service of a worker who never left it, or the seniority retained on choosing the new system. Severed at one month’s average wage a year under 勞基法 §17 (a part month counts whole); on a §53/§54 retirement paid as retirement pay under 勞基法 §55 (RETIREMENT_PAY).

notice_days_given.description: 勞基法 §16: calendar days from the day after notice to the last working day. The shortfall against 10 / 20 / 30 days is paid at the day wage.

retirement_disability.description: 勞基法 §54(1)(2): the employer retired the worker as 身心障礙不堪勝任工作, which makes a retirement eligible at any age or service. Unrecorded is no.

retirement_disability_duty_caused.description: 勞基法 §55(1)(2): the §54(1)(2) disability was caused by performing the job; the retirement pay is increased by 20%. Unrecorded is no.

occupational_death.description: 勞基法 §59(4): the worker died of an occupational injury or occupational disease. The employer pays five months’ 平均工資 as funeral costs and forty months’ as death compensation to the survivors (OCC_DEATH_FUNERAL, OCC_DEATH_COMPENSATION), 平均工資 read as SEVERANCE_PAY reads it (`average_daily_wage` × 30 where stated). Unrecorded is no.

reference_number.description: The insurer's enrolment reference (勞保/健保/勞退 加保 notice).

pension_system.description: LABOR_PENSION — 勞工退休金條例 §8–9 (and, from 2026, 外國專業人才延攬及僱用法 §24): LSA where the worker kept the 勞動基準法 (old) pension system; LABOR_PENSION then charges nothing and LABOR_PENSION_RESERVE carries the worker's wages. Unrecorded is the new system.

employer_rate.description: LABOR_PENSION — 勞工退休金條例 §14(1): the employer's declared contribution rate, not below 6% of the 月提繳工資. Unrecorded is 6.

voluntary_rate.description: LABOR_PENSION — 勞工退休金條例 §14(3): the worker's voluntary contribution, up to 6% of the 月提繳工資, deducted from pay. Unrecorded is none.

insured_elsewhere.description: NHI — 全民健康保險法 §31(1)(2): the worker is not insured for NHI through this unit (another employer, a union or as a dependant). No regular NHI premium is charged here and every salary payment of at least the minimum wage attracts the 2.11% NHI_PART_TIME premium. Unrecorded is no.

enrolled_dependants.description: NHI — 全民健康保險法 §18(2): the dependants enrolled with the worker under this unit; the worker's premium covers at most three. Unrecorded is none.

exempt.description: NHI_PART_TIME — NHIA 二代健保補充保險費簡介: a 第2類 insured's salary income, and a person with no NHI eligibility or a 第5類 insured, is not assessed. Unrecorded is no.

insured_amount.description: LI, NHI, LABOR_PENSION, OCC_INJURY — the insurer-confirmed monthly insured grade (月投保薪資 / 投保金額 / 月提繳工資) declared for that scheme (勞工保險條例 §14, 全民健康保險法 §20, 勞工退休金條例 §14–15, 勞工職業災害保險及保護法 §17). EI and the wage arrears levy read the LI one. Unrecorded is the grade of the month's wage.

exemptions.description: INCOME_TAX — 薪資所得扣繳辦法 §6–7: the number of spouse and dependants the worker declared on the 薪資受領人免稅額申報表. Declared, regular salary is withheld by the 薪資所得扣繳稅額表 (its own formula); unrecorded, by the 5% method.

continued_after_65.description: LI — a worker over 65 who has not claimed the old-age benefit and continues in labour insurance (勞工保險條例 §9-1; BLI 年逾65歲繼續工作者得繼續參加勞保): charged at 12.5% (no employment insurance after 65).

disability_subsidy.description: LI (and EI) or NHI — 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73: the government pays this percentage of the disabled worker’s own premium share (極重度/重度 100, 中度 50, 輕度 25).

part_time_income.description: INCOME_TAX — the salary here is 兼職所得 (a second employer, no 免稅額申報表 here): withheld 5% of each payment reaching the 起扣標準 (薪資所得扣繳辦法 §7).

facts.description: Person facts held on employment_profile.facts (CEL employee.facts.*).

foreign_spouse_of_national.description: 就業保險法 §5(1)(2) and 勞工退休金條例 §7(1)(2): a foreigner (or mainland, Hong Kong or Macao resident) married to a national with household registration and permitted to reside and work in Taiwan; covered by employment insurance and the new labour pension. Unrecorded is no.

foreign_professional.description: 外國專業人才延攬及僱用法 §24–25 as amended (公布 2025-09-24, 施行 2026-01-01), in force 2026-01-01: a foreign professional, special professional or senior professional. Without permanent residence they enter the new labour pension (unless an existing worker elected in writing by 30 June 2026 to keep the LSA pension: record pension_system LSA); with permanent residence they also enter employment insurance. Unrecorded is no.

migrant_worker.description: 就業服務法 §46(1)(8)–(11) migrant worker. 勞動部 114年10月14日勞動福3字第1140153402A號令: from 1 April 2026 such a worker with under ten years at the unit is left out of the 勞動基準法 §56 reserve wage total. Unrecorded is no.

food_lodging_monthly_cap.description: The monthly food and lodging amount in the migrant worker’s signed 外國人入國工作費用及工資切結書; FOOD_LODGING deductions above it are refused.

voting_right.description: 公職人員選舉罷免法 §14–15 / 公民投票法: whether the worker may vote in the 投票日 holiday (a SPECIAL_HOLIDAY). Blank reads a national of twenty or more on the day.

indigenous.description: 原住民身分法: an indigenous worker, given the INDIGENOUS_RITUAL_HOLIDAY: three days a year (紀念日及節日實施條例 §6(1)(3)).

tribe.description: The worker’s 原住民族 (e.g. 阿美族), whose 歲時祭儀 date the 原住民族委員會 announces.

entity_input_schema.title: TW entity inputs

shift_or_continuous_work.description: 勞動基準法 §35: 勞工繼續工作四小時，至少應有三十分鐘之休息。但實行輪班制或其工作有連續性或緊急性者，雇主得在工作時間內，另行調配其休息時間 — true where the entity runs shifts or continuous work and so rearranges the break inside working time. Unrecorded is the rule, not its exception: false.

responsibility_system.description: 勞動基準法 §84-1: an approved responsibility system (責任制) for a category the central authority has announced, with a written agreement filed with the local authority, sets hours outside §30, §32, §36, §37 and §49. It is an exception that must be approved; unrecorded is none: false.

welfare_committee_established.description: 職工福利金條例 §1: 凡公營、私營之工廠、礦場或其他企業組織，均應提撥職工福利金，辦理職工福利事業; §2(1)(3): 每月於每個職員工人薪津內各扣百分之○‧五 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0040001, last amended 2015-07-01). True where this entity has established its 職工福利委員會 and the fund the deduction is paid into: the WELFARE_FUND scheme then withholds 0.5% of every worker's 薪津 each month (temporary workers included: 勞委會 93-02-17 勞福一字第0930006802號函). Unrecorded is no committee: false, and nothing is withheld.

pension_reserve_rate.description: 勞動基準法 §56(1): 雇主應依勞工每月薪資總額百分之二至百分之十五範圍內，按月提撥勞工退休準備金 — the percentage the competent authority approved for this entity. Required once the entity employs a worker on the LSA pension (pension_system LSA, or a foreign worker outside 勞工退休金條例 §7): LABOR_PENSION_RESERVE refuses the run by name while it is unrecorded.

li_unit_class.description: COMPANY_OR_SHOP is a company or registered shop under Labour Insurance Act §6(1)(2). Its LI mandate begins at five employees; EI and occupational insurance remain mandatory for eligible workers below five. BLI: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0018645.html

li_no_insurance_unit.description: True only with BLI-confirmed unit history showing that this company/shop has fewer than five workers, never entered mandatory LI, and has not opened a voluntary LI unit. A formerly mandatory unit remains mandatory after its workforce drops to four; an optional unit cannot selectively omit employees. EI and occupational cover still apply. BLI: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0102422.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0018645.html

li_unit_evidence_reference.description: Reference the dated BLI unit-status and employer headcount history supporting li_no_insurance_unit. It does not substitute for EI/OCC enrolment evidence.

time_off_in_lieu_months.description: 勞動基準法 §32-1(2): 補休期限由勞雇雙方協商 — the months after the day worked within which hours elected as 補休 are to be taken, as the worker and the employer agreed. Leave it unrecorded where no period was agreed: 施行細則 §22-2(1) and MOL's 加班補休規定 Q&A make the last day of the annual-leave year the final deadline, which also caps any longer agreement.

bli_insurance_unit_number.description: 勞保局 保險證號 of the 投保單位 — the one number labour, employment and occupational accident insurance and the labour pension are filed under (勞工保險條例 §10, 勞工職業災害保險及保護法 §12, 勞工退休金條例 §18).

nhi_unit_code.description: 健保署 投保單位代號 (全民健康保險法 §15).

withholding_agent_number.description: 扣繳單位統一編號 — the withholding agent's tax registration number on the 扣繳憑單 (所得稅法 §89, §92).

employment_stabilisation_fee_payer.description: 就業服務法 §55: the entity employs foreign workers in 就業服務法 §46(1)(8)–(10) work and pays the 就業安定費 on the WDA's quarterly bill; the EMPLOYMENT_STABILISATION_FEE task is then raised each February, May, August and November. Unrecorded is no.

occ_experience_rate_percent.description: 勞工職業災害保險及保護法 §16(4): the unit's experience-rated total premium rate (實績費率, commuting rate included) the Bureau notified for the year, in percent. Recorded, OCC_INJURY charges it instead of the industry table rate of the entity's risk class.

day_wage_calendar_days.description: 勞動部 102年11月15日勞動2字第1020083156號函: a day of a monthly wage is monthly ÷ the month’s calendar days instead of ÷ 30 where the parties so agreed; applied to part months, unpaid days and every day rate alike. Unrecorded is ÷ 30.

disabled_employees_counted.description: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §38(3): the disabled employees counted toward the quota this month (a 重度 disability counts twice). Read by DISABLED_EMPLOYMENT_QUOTA_LEVY for an employer of 67 or more.

flexible_working_time.description: 勞動基準法 §30(2)–(3), §30-1, §36(2): the entity applies an approved 2-, 4- or 8-week flexible working-time scheme; the daily/weekly normal-hours and seven-day rest checks then do not apply.

women_night_work_consent.description: 勞動基準法 §49(1): the union (or, without one, the labour-management conference) consented to women working 22:00–06:00 and the safety facilities are in place.

shift_change_rest_eight_hours.description: 勞動基準法 §34(2) 但書: the industry is announced by the central authority and the union or conference agreed to eight hours between shifts instead of eleven.

work_rules_approval_reference.description: 勞動基準法 §70; 施行細則 §37: the local authority's approval reference for the work rules; while unrecorded, WORK_RULES_FILING is raised by each hire of an entity of thirty or more.

address.description: 勞工保險條例施行細則 §17; 全民健康保險法施行細則 §42: the insuring unit’s registered address — a change raises LI_UNIT_CHANGE and NHI_UNIT_CHANGE.

responsible_person.description: 勞工保險條例施行細則 §17; 全民健康保險法施行細則 §42: the unit’s responsible person (負責人) — a change raises LI_UNIT_CHANGE and NHI_UNIT_CHANGE.

sexual_harassment_complaint_channel.description: 性別平等工作法 §13(1)(1): the complaint channel is set up and posted (ten to twenty-nine employed).

sexual_harassment_prevention_rules.description: 性別平等工作法 §13(1)(2): prevention measures and complaint and discipline rules adopted and posted (thirty or more).

overtime_extension_approval_on.description: 勞動基準法 §32(1)–(2): the day the union (or, with no union, the labour-management conference) approved extending overtime beyond 46 hours a month — to 54, and 138 in three months. Blank is no approval: the statute’s 46 hours.

overtime_extension_approved_by.description: 勞動基準法 §32(1): the body that gave the approval — the union, or the labour-management conference where the employer has no union.

pension_reserve_excludes_short_service_m.description: 勞動部 114年10月14日勞動福3字第1140153402A號令: from 2026-04-01 the employer may leave a blue-collar migrant worker with under ten years at the unit out of the §56(1) reserve wage total (其工資可不計入). Unrecorded: they stay in.

entity_input_schema.description: The entity facts (entity.facts) the TW records read. The 職業災害保險 industry class is the entity's own risk_class column (1–55, 勞工職業災害保險適用行業別及費率表), not a fact.
